title: PayPal's agent card terms leave disputes to card chargebacks
summary: PayPal's merchant terms for purchases made by AI agents took effect on 23 November. An agent pays with a single-use PayPal virtual card at the merchant's card checkout, refunds go back to that card, and the payments carry no PayPal Seller Protection, so disputes run as card chargebacks.
whyItMatters: Liability for agent purchases is hardening on the merchant side, alongside the banks' own at-your-own-risk terms.
